alloy.preparation: Low-N K0 obtained by denitriding in hydrogen for 72 h at 1200 °C, followed by cold rolling to reduce grain size and final annealing for 20 min at 1100 °C. Wet surface ground to 600-mesh SiC; passivated in air for at least 18 h before pitting testing. For potential measurements, combination of passivation and lacquering avoided crevice corrosion; 1 cm² of flat surface exposed.
alloy.microstructure: Austenitic experimental stainless steel. Grain size reduced by cold rolling; an individual final numerical grain size is not separately specified for the denitrided alloy.

test_solution.preparation: Figure 3 potential measurements in 1 M NaCl. Solvent grade, bulk pH and gas conditioning are not separately stated for this protocol.

test_method.procedure_description: Potential scanned anodically from the corrosion potential at 20 mV/min, Figure 3 K0 at 40 °C; potentials versus SCE. Only 1 cm² of flat surface exposed. Replicate/run pairings between open Eb and filled Einit markers are not supplied. No fixed numerical current threshold is reported. The 0.2 M NaCl/+600 mV temperature-ramp CPT protocol and argon-deaerated passive/active tests in other electrolytes are separate experiments.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Eb: final breakdown potential, open-diamond marker.

experiments.result_note: Approximate manual marker reading. Eb is final breakdown; Einit is the onset of the first repassivating pits, not a protection/repassivation potential. Each visible occurrence is retained; the source gives no replicate/run labels, so Eb and Einit markers are not paired to one another. Fitted lines do not create observations. Table 1 supplies bulk wt.% analyses; S is strictly <0.003 wt.% for every alloy. Fe amount/balance is not reported. Heat-treatment temperatures and the 20/60 °C microscopy-immersion temperatures are not the Figure 3 test temperatures. Individual marker occurrences are retained without inventing replicate identities or Eb/Einit pairs.
